title: Kernova
description: A lightweight optimization foundation for Minecraft, built for clean performance, stability, and modpack-ready setups.
body: ![Kernova preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/39481acf796a8bcdbfd3b4a1229c59e535fdf00c_0.webp) A lightweight optimization foundation for Minecraft, built for clean performance, stability, and modpack-ready setups. It focuses on improving the client experience without changing the core gameplay. No content expansion, no heavy modifications - just a clean technical base for smoother gameplay. ## Features - Lightweight performance-focused setup - Clean client-side optimization - Stable base for everyday gameplay - Suitable for modpack creators - No unnecessary gameplay changes - Built around a minimal and technical approach ## For players Kernova is made for players who want a smoother Minecraft experience without turning the game into something else. Install it, launch the game, and play with a cleaner optimized setup. ## For modpack creators Kernova can be used as a foundation for your own modpack. It provides a lightweight optimization base that you can build on top of without starting from zero. ## Performance Vanilla Minecraft and Kernova compared under the same scene and settings.
